_comment: Name rules for recognising another upload of the same work (BUG-662).
Names are compared after lower-casing and turning every run of
punctuation or spaces into one space.
file_name_markers: regular expressions for what a re-save or revision
adds to the END of a file name ('(1)', '-copy', '_v2', ' final'). They
are removed, repeatedly, from file names only; titles and team names
are compared as written, so 'System 2' never merges with 'System'.
generic_words / generic_token_patterns: a name whose every word is one of
these says nothing about which work it is ('BSIT Capstone Manuscript',
'Group 3', 'IT41S2-G3'), so it never counts as the same name, and such
words never count when deciding whether two recorded names disagree.
Edit this file, not code, to change any list.
Common capstone title words (system, online, platform...) are generic too, so two titles agree only on the words that tell projects apart.
